workflows.sub: Chains of steps that prepare ideas, posts and planner items from your content.
workflows.localOnly: Runs only while this browser is open on this device. Nothing is scheduled in the cloud; nothing is posted and no one is replied to.
workflows.storageBlocked: This browser isn't saving right now (storage blocked or full), so workflows can't be saved or run.
workflows.emptyHint: Try: article ready → idea + post + planner item.
workflows.triggerHelp.manual: You start it with Run now.
workflows.triggerHelp.article-ready: Runs when you move an article from draft to Ready in Website.
workflows.pausedNote: Run now is off while paused, and Ready articles don't start it.
workflows.placeholdersHelp: You can use in the text:
workflows.previewNote: Preview only: nothing was saved or sent.
workflows.previewSampleNone: On a sample article (no article is ready yet)
workflows.previewSkipped: Would be skipped: an earlier step failed
workflows.save.notPersisted: Not saved: the browser didn't keep the change. Your edits are still here.
workflows.save.unsupported: This browser can't save safely (no Web Locks), so nothing was saved.
workflows.save.conflict: Changed in another tab or by an import. Your edits are still here; nothing was overwritten.
workflows.issue.plan-skill: The planner item's skill doesn't exist
workflows.issue.skill-needs-article: Pick a skill for the planner item (a manual run has no article)
workflows.issue.placeholder-needs-articl: Title, summary and slug need an article: run it “When an article is ready”
workflows.runError.not-retryable: This run doesn't need a retry.
workflows.gone: This workflow doesn't exist on this device.
workflows.needsArticle: This workflow needs an article: write one in Website first, then run it on that article.
workflows.resumeNote: The run stopped because the browser didn't save a step. Resume continues where it stopped, without repeating.
workflows.unsavedPrompt: You have unsaved edits from last time. Restore them?
workflows.runError.not-local: This workflow is linked to the cloud Worker (or that link isn't clear yet), so it won't run on this device. Nothing ran.
